title: Contact
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 27.4 Linked Discourses 27.4
  • 1. Kilesavagga 1. Corruptions

Samphassasutta Contact

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Yo, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassasmiṁ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso. “Mendicants, desire and greed for eye contact, Yo sotasamphassasmiṁ … ear contact, yo ghānasamphassasmiṁ … nose contact, yo jivhāsamphassasmiṁ … tongue contact, yo kāyasamphassasmiṁ … body contact, yo manosamphassasmiṁ chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso. or mind contact is a corruption of the mind. …” Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno …pe… abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū”ti.

Catutthaṁ.
